sources.title: How to Customize an LLM for AI Agents using SFT and QLoRA
sources.snippet: In this tutorial, I'll show you how to fine-tune a large language model for use in AI agents using supervised fine-tuning with QLoRA. This lets us customize a pre-trained model so it behaves the way we want. We'll use a lightweight training workflow to update only a small part of the model.
